info.title: Plinth API
info.description: Non-custodial multi-chain USDC payment gateway. Amounts are decimal strings in USDC (`"12.50"`) with exact integer base-unit twins (`*_units`). Test keys (`sk_test_`) operate on testnets; live keys (`sk_live_`) on mainnets.

get.summary: Public network status for the status page
get.description: Operational state per network and queue depth. Contains no merchant data.

post.summary: Create a merchant account
Sign in to the dashboard

200.description: A session token. Treat as a password.

post.summary: Sign in or sign up with a Web3Auth identity token

200.description: A session token. The identity token is verified against Web3Auth's published keys for this deployment's client id.

post.summary: End the current session
Sign out everywhere else
post.description: Ends every other dashboard session of the signed-in user and keeps the current one.

post.summary: Change the password
post.description: Needs the current password. Every other session of the user is ended.

get.summary: Email address status for the signed-in user
get.description: Whether the account has a real email, whether it is verified, how the user signs in (so the dashboard knows how to ask for re-authentication) and whether this server can send email.

post.summary: Send a verification link to the account email
Add or replace the account email
post.description: Needs a fresh sign-in (`reauth`): the current password, or a Web3Auth identity token issued in the last few minutes. The address only changes when the link sent to it is used.

post.summary: Use the link from a verification email
post.description: Single use. The web app opens this from `/verify-email?token=…`.

post.summary: Create a payment intent
post.description: Returns the hosted checkout URL and, per network, a unique counterfactual USDC deposit address. Use `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds the payment stays payable (300 to 2592000). Omit to use the merchant's default expiry, which is 1200 (20 minutes) unless changed in settings.

get.summary: Payment detail with timeline, transfers, settlements and attempts

post.summary: Create a reusable payment link

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

currency.description: The token the link is paid in. USDC everywhere; EURC where the network supports it.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a payment link

post.summary: Create an invoice

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

currency.description: The token the invoice is paid in. Line item amounts are in this token.

get.summary: Supported networks, capabilities and your vault status

get.description: Only the official, Circle-issued native USDC contract of each network is accepted. Bridged variants are not.

get.summary: On-chain movements observed for your payments
Dashboard metrics (received vs settled are labelled separately)

post.summary: Request a refund
post.description: A refund is a NEW transfer from your vault, sent by you. It completes only after that transfer is verified on-chain (see proof).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

post.summary: Submit the vault→recipient transaction that fulfils a refund
Reject an open refund request
Create a webhook endpoint
post.description: The signing secret is returned once. Events: payment.detected, payment.confirmed, payment.completed, payment.underpaid, payment.overpaid, payment.expired, payment.late, payment.invalid_asset, settlement.submitted, settlement.completed, settlement.failed, refund.requested, refund.completed, payout.requested, payout.confirmed, payout.switched_to_vault, payout.cancelled.

post.summary: Retry a failed or abandoned delivery

get.summary: How you are paid on each network
get.description: Per network: the mode in use (`VAULT` or `DIRECT`), where the money goes, the platform fee and treasury, the vault, and any change that is waiting for its email link or its cooldown.

post.summary: Get the message a wallet must sign to prove control
post.description: Returns a Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) message that expires in ten minutes. The wallet signs it with `personal_sign`; the signature is single use. Plain wallets (EOAs) only; smart-contract wallets are not supported in this version.

post.summary: Ask to be paid directly to your own wallet
post.description: Needs a verified email, the signed challenge, and a fresh sign-in (`reauth`). The change only starts after you open the link emailed to you, plus the cooldown. Invoices that already have an address keep the destination they were issued with.

post.summary: Go back to being paid into your vault
post.description: Applies immediately to new invoices. Needs a fresh sign-in.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or cooling-down payout change
Use the link from a payout confirmation email
post.description: Single use. The web app opens this from `/confirm-payout?token=…`. Starts the cooldown.

get.summary: Custody balances per network and token, and where they can be withdrawn
get.description: Only meaningful for merchants in the custodial payout mode, where the platform holds the balance. `available` is false on networks where custody is switched off. Amounts are in each token's own units; they are never added across tokens.

post.summary: Withdraw your custody balance to your proven withdrawal wallet
post.description: Needs a fresh sign-in (`reauth`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: repeating the same key returns the same withdrawal. Omit `amount` to withdraw everything. The destination is never chosen in the request: it is the withdrawal wallet you proved and confirmed by email.

patch.summary: Set automatic payouts of a custody balance
patch.description: MANUAL, DAILY or WEEKLY. A scheduled payout sends the whole balance in one transfer, only when it is at least `min_amount`, and needs a confirmed withdrawal wallet.

post.summary: Enable a network: create your settlement vault
post.description: `owner_address` becomes the sole owner of the vault. Use a multisig. The gateway never holds an administrative role.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

get.summary: Live on-chain vault state (owner, policy, balance)

post.summary: Re-check an externally deployed vault on-chain
Build the transaction that changes your on-chain settlement policy
post.description: Returns calldata only. Sign and send it from the vault owner wallet; the gateway cannot execute it.

get.summary: Accounting policy and per-network vault policies
List API keys (secrets are never shown again)

post.summary: Create an API key
post.description: The full key is returned exactly once.

post.summary: Rotate a key (new key issued, old key revoked)
Add a team member
post.description: Needs a fresh sign-in (`reauth`). Every owner and admin with a verified email is told. The returned temporary password is shown once.

post.summary: Remove a team member
post.description: Needs a fresh sign-in (`reauth`). The member's sessions end at once.

post.summary: Prepare a gasless EIP-3009 authorization for the paying wallet
Submit the signed authorization for relaying
post.description: The signature is validated against the exact payload issued by `prepare`. Treat signatures as sensitive: they are never logged.

post.summary: Open a payment link: creates a fresh payment
Set or clear one merchant's platform fee
post.description: Basis points, 0 to 100 (the on-chain cap). `null` returns the merchant to the platform default. Applies to invoices created afterwards.

get.summary: Relayer queue, balances and spend per network

post.summary: Emergency stop: disable NEW relayer actions
Resume relayer actions

x-webhooks.signature: Plinth-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${t}.${rawBody}`)>; reject if |now - t| > 300s
x-webhooks.retries: 8 attempts over ~10 hours with exponential back-off; every attempt is logged. Handlers must be idempotent (dedupe on event.id).
